allyofjusticecatastor.name: Ally of Justice Catastor
allyofjusticecatastor.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles a face-up non-DARK monster: Destroy that monster.

ancientwarriorsvirtuousliuxuan.name: Ancient Warriors - Virtuous Liu Xuan
ancientwarriorsvirtuousliuxuan.desc:
While you control another "Ancient Warriors" monster, your opponent's monsters cannot target this card for attacks. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ancient Warriors - Virtuous Liu Xuan" once per turn.
● If your opponent controls more monsters than you do: You can send 1 card from your hand or field to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Ancient Warriors" monster from your Deck, except "Ancient Warriors - Virtuous Liu Xuan". ● When an attack is declared involving another "Ancient Warriors" monster you control: You can draw 1 card.

darkrosefairy.name: Dark Rose Fairy
darkrosefairy.desc: If a Tuner(s) is Special Summoned (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is in your GY: You can send 1 card from your hand or field to the GY; place this card on the top or bottom of your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Dark Rose Fairy" once per turn.

destinydrawskillcard.name: Destiny Draw (Skill Card)
destinydrawskillcard.desc:
[If you lose 2000 or more LP, you can activate this Skill during your next Draw Phase.]

During your Draw Phase, you may search your Deck for any card, reveal it to your opponent, and add it to your hand instead of drawing. If you do that, flip this card over.

digitron.name: Digitron
digitron.desc: A subspecies found in electronic space. There's little information on it.

dramaturgeofdespia.name: Dramaturge of Despia
dramaturgeofdespia.desc: If a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster is Special Summoned (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 Effect Monster on the field; negate its effects until the end of this turn. If this card in your hand or field is used as Fusion Material, and sent to the GY or banished: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Dramaturge of Despia" once per turn.

edeatheheavenlysquire.name: Edea the Heavenly Squire
edeatheheavenlysquire.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 monster with 800 ATK and 1000 DEF from your Deck in Defense Position, except "Edea the Heavenly Squire", also you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn. If this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 of your banished "Monarch" Spell/Trap Cards; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Edea the Heavenly Squire" once per turn.

fortuneladylight.name: Fortune Lady Light
fortuneladylight.desc: This card's ATK/DEF become its Level x 200. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Increase this card's Level by 1 (max. 12). When this face-up card leaves the field by card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Fortune Lady" monster from your Deck.

geminitraphole.name: Gemini Trap Hole
geminitraphole.desc: Activate only when a Gemini monster that is treated as an Effect Monster is destroyed by battle. Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

giftofthemartyr.name: Gift of the Martyr
giftofthemartyr.desc: Send 1 monster on your side of the field to the Graveyard. Select 1 monster on your side of the field. The selected monster gains ATK equal to the ATK of the sent monster until the end of this turn.

heraldicbeastbernersfalcon.name: Heraldic Beast Berners Falcon
heraldicbeastbernersfalcon.desc: When this card is Summoned: You can make all face-up Level 5 or higher monsters you currently control become Level 4.

hydrogenex.name: Hydro Genex
hydrogenex.desc:
"Genex Controller" + 1 or more non-Tuner WATER monsters
When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, gain Life Points equal to the ATK of the destroyed monster.

judgmentofanubis.name: Judgment of Anubis
judgmentofanubis.desc: When your opponent activates a Spell Card that would destroy a Spell/Trap Card(s) on the field: Discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it, then you can destroy 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, and if you do that, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the destroyed monster's ATK on the field.

karateman.name: Karate Man
karateman.desc: You can double the original ATK of this card once per turn. If you used this effect, destroy this card during the End Phase.

keymace.name: Key Mace
keymace.desc: Enemies' hearts will melt at the sight of this small fairy's cuteness.

kuriboo.name: Kuriboo
kuriboo.desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Kuriboh" card.)
When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can discard this card; add 1 "Kuriboh" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Kuriboo". Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 Trap, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; it loses 1500 ATK until the end of this turn.

lavallakesidelady.name: Laval Lakeside Lady
lavallakesidelady.desc: If this card is in your Graveyard and you have 3 or more "Laval" monsters with different names in your Graveyard: You can banish this card and 1 other "Laval" monster from your Graveyard to target 1 Set card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

learningelf.name: Learning Elf
learningelf.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Set 1 Trap from your Deck with an effect that equips itself to a monster. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Learning Elf" once per turn.

nightmaremagician.name: Nightmare Magician
nightmaremagician.desc: If this card battles a monster, neither can be destroyed by that battle. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card battled an opponent's monster: You can take control of that opponent's monster. Once per turn, at the start of the Damage Step, if another monster attacks: You can destroy 1 card on the field.

painfulescape.name: Painful Escape
painfulescape.desc: Tribute 1 monster; add 1 monster with the same original Type, Attribute, and Level, but with a different original name, from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

radianttyphoonchant.name: Radiant Typhoon Chant

radiantvouirescence.name: Radiant Vouirescence
radiantvouirescence.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned while your opponent controls a monster: You can discard 1 card; send any number of "Radiant Vouirescence" from your Deck to the GY. Once per turn, if this card is in your GY: You can make this card in the GY become DARK until the end of this turn.

rankupmagicmagicalforce.name: Rank-Up-Magic Magical Force
rankupmagicmagicalforce.desc: Target 1 Rank 4 Spellcaster Xyz Monster in your GY; Special Summon it (but negate its effects), then Special Summon 1 Rank 5 Spellcaster Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck, by using it as material, and if you do, attach this card to the Summoned monster (this is treated as an Xyz Summon). You can only activate 1 "Rank-Up-Magic Magical Force" per turn.

royaltribute.name: Royal Tribute
royaltribute.desc: If you control "Necrovalley": Both players discard any monsters in their hands.

seventheternity.name: Seventh Eternity
seventheternity.desc:
Target 1 "Number" Xyz Monster you control that has a number between "101" and "107" in its name, or 1 Xyz Monster you control that has any such monsters as material, then activate 1 of these effects;
● Negate the effects of 1 monster your opponent controls with ATK less than or equal to the targeted monster's ATK, until the end of this turn.
● Detach all materials from the targeted monster, then you can Special Summon 1 "Number" Xyz Monster from your GY.
You can only use this effect of "Seventh Eternity" once per turn.

spiritofthebreeze.name: Spirit of the Breeze
spiritofthebreeze.desc: As long as this card remains in face-up Attack Position on your side of the field, increase your Life Points by 1000 points during each of your Standby Phases.

steelswarmgatekeeper.name: Steelswarm Gatekeeper
steelswarmgatekeeper.desc: If a "Steelswarm" monster is Tribute Summoned face-up while this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon or Set 1 monster in addition to your Normal Summon or Set that turn.

stormshooter.name: Storm Shooter
stormshooter.desc: Once per turn, you can select and activate 1 of these effects: ● Move this card to an adjacent (horizontal) unoccupied Monster Card Zone. ● Return 1 Spell, Trap or Monster Card on your opponent's side of the field in the same column as this card to its owner's hand.

tenyispiritashuna.name: Tenyi Spirit - Ashuna
tenyispiritashuna.desc: If you control no Effect Monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If you control a face-up non-Effect Monster: You can banish this card from your hand or GY; Special Summon 1 "Tenyi" monster from your Deck, except "Tenyi Spirit - Ashuna", also you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except Wyrm monsters. You can only use each effect of "Tenyi Spirit - Ashuna" once per turn.

theorealizepastlull.name: Theorealize Past Lull
theorealizepastlull.desc: If you control an "Artmage", "DoomZ", or "Elfnote" card: You can Special Summon 1 "Medius the Pure" from your hand or Deck. Your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when that monster is Special Summoned. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Monster in your GY; Special Summon it to your zone a Link Monster points to. You can only use 1 "Theorealize Past Lull" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

thezombievampire.name: The Zombie Vampire
thezombievampire.desc:
2+ Level 8 monsters
If you use a monster(s) with a Level that is owned by your opponent for the Xyz Summon of this card, treat it as Level 8. Neither player can target this card with effects of Special Summoned monsters, except those Special Summoned from the GY. You can detach 1 material from this card; each player sends the top 4 cards from their Deck to the GY, then if any monsters were sent to either GY by this effect, you can Special Summon 1 of those monsters to your field. You can only use this effect of "The Zombie Vampire" once per turn.

ursarcticbigdipper.name: Ursarctic Big Dipper
ursarcticbigdipper.desc: Once per turn, if your "Ursarctic" monster would Tribute a monster(s) to activate its effect, you can banish 1 Level 7 or higher "Ursarctic" monster from your GY instead. Each time a monster(s) is Special Summoned, place 1 counter on this card. Once per turn, if a monster(s) is Special Summoned and an "Ursarctic" Synchro Monster is on the field (except during the Damage Step): You can remove all counters from this card (min. 7), then target 1 monster your opponent controls; take control of it.

vanquishsoulpantera.name: Vanquish Soul Pantera
vanquishsoulpantera.desc:
If you control no monsters in your Main Monster Zone: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. (Quick Effect): You can activate 1 of these effects, by revealing monster(s) in your hand with the listed Attribute(s);
● EARTH: This card cannot be destroyed by battle this turn.
● EARTH & FIRE: Destroy all Spells/Traps in this card's column.
You can only use each effect of "Vanquish Soul Pantera" once per turn, and cannot activate more than 1 in the same Chain.

voidtraphole.name: Void Trap Hole
voidtraphole.desc: When your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) with 2000 or more ATK: Negate the effects of 1 of those monsters with 2000 or more ATK, and if you do, destroy it.

wormnoble.name: Worm Noble
wormnoble.desc: FLIP: If this card is flipped face-up by an opponent's monster's attack, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the attacking monster's ATK.

zoroathemagistusconflagrantcalamity.name: Zoroa, the Magistus Conflagrant Calamity
zoroathemagistusconflagrantcalamity.desc:
1 Spellcaster Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can equip 1 "Magistus" monster from your Extra Deck to this card. Your opponent cannot activate the effects of monsters with the same card type (Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link) as a "Magistus" Monster Card in your Spell & Trap Zone. If this card is in your GY: You can target 1 "Magistus" card you control; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Zoroa, the Magistus Conflagrant Calamity" once per turn.
